newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins Danish DCS 1800 order.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins Danish DCS 1800 order.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had won a 350 million Danish crown order for DCS 1800 mobile telephone network infrastructure from Mobilix, a subsidiary of France Telecom.
"The contract totals 350 million Danish crowns and will secure Mobilix a technological lead in the future Danish DCS 1800 network," Nokia said.

"The agreement comprises the complete infrastructure for the new Mobilix DCS 1800 network and includes the Nokia Mobile Switching Centre (MSC), Base Station Controller (BSC) and the Nokia Base Transceiver Station (BTS)," it said, adding it also included the Nokia DX 220 switch for international fixed network connections.

It said the Mobilix network would provide full data transmission support via the Nokia Artus Data Communication Server (DaCS) which can connect a mobile phone to the Internet within only a few seconds.
